label: No actual root could have a determination it lacks
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every actual concrete root r of the selected grounding relation at w, every world v accessible from w in the supplied frame and every determination d, if r really has d at v then r really has d at w. The root's absences are NECESSARY_11 (a box over the frame's accessibility from w): it could not have had a determination it actually lacks. It says nothing about why they are. A root whose profile is contingent (as on a Humean recombination account) denies it. So does a classical root whose free selection of one undominated outcome is a real intrinsic determination that differs at an accessible world (Lean-only classicalSelectionControl); a classical root keeps it only on the relation-of-reason reading, on which the selection adds no real intrinsic determination, which is open.
